# Agent Client Collector Framework 6.6.3 - no agent package

ServiceNow released the Framework app 6.6.3 on the Store, but the download server holds no agent package numbered 6.6.3. A Framework release installs whichever agent build its property sn_agent.agent_version names, and that number can differ from the app's own; agent changes in these notes reached hosts through a neighbouring agent build. See the [index](README.md) for the agent versions around it.

## Change log

Agent Client Collector Framework 6.6.3: Patch release, published on the Store 2026-08-07, for the Australia, Zurich, Yokohama platform families.

**Fixed**

- RPM upgrades on Linux now remove the .pem and .bin files left in the upgrade directory.
- Host data collection failed on Windows Server 2012 R2 because of an asset clean-up error.
- Windows installs of versions after 6.5.1 failed while creating the servicenow user.

**Security and library updates**

- OpenSSL 3.4.6 and net-imap 0.5.15.

**Observed by this harness**

- No agent package is numbered 6.6.3. Agent 6.6.2 already embeds OpenSSL 3.4.6 and net-imap 0.5.15, so this Framework release most likely delivered agent build 6.6.2 (read from the packages with `acctest runtimes`).

Summarised from ServiceNow's release notes; the full text is on the [Store listing](https://store.servicenow.com/store/app/bc09636e1be06a50a85b16db234bcbd1) under Version details, Release notes.
